## 更新内容

- 视觉更新：统一升级主导航、仪表盘、工作流页面、任务队列、模板库、设置页、设置引导、蓝光拆分、自动压制、音频处理和 VapourSynth 工作区的布局、层级、状态展示与交互反馈；完善响应式布局、动效、减少动画和高对比度支持
- 任务工作流：补充视频队列、音频处理、自动压制和蓝光拆分的任务状态、进度、取消和失败详情展示
- 模板库：完善模板加载、保存、编辑、删除和空状态反馈
- 文件对话框：记住最近使用的目录，后续打开同类对话框时优先使用该目录

## Update Notes

- Visual update: refreshed the navigation shell, dashboard, workflow pages, video queue, template library, settings, setup guide, Blu-ray demux, auto compression, audio processing, and VapourSynth workspace with consistent hierarchy, responsive layouts, task presentation, interaction feedback, motion, reduced-motion behavior, and high-contrast support
- Task workflows: added task status, progress, cancellation, and failure-detail presentation for the video queue, audio processing, auto compression, and Blu-ray demux workflows
- Template library: improved loading, save, edit, delete, and empty-state feedback
- File dialogs: remember the most recently used directory and prefer it when opening the same kind of dialog again
